exercises.title: 九年级 U11 听力·对话 Sad Movies
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: Do you like sad movies?
M: Not really. Sad movies make me cry.
W: I know what you mean. But I think they make me think.
M: I prefer funny movies. They make me laugh.
W: Well, different movies make us feel different things.
exercises.translation_cn:
女:你喜欢悲伤的电影吗?
男:不太喜欢。悲伤的电影让我哭。
女:我懂你的意思。但我觉得它们让我思考。
男:我更喜欢搞笑的电影,它们让我笑。
女:嗯,不同的电影让我们有不同的感受。

questions.stem: How do sad movies make the man feel?
What do sad movies make the woman do?
What kind of movies does the man prefer?
What do funny movies make the man do?
What do different movies make us feel?

exercises.title: 九年级 U11 听力·短文 The Happy Man's Shirt
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: Long ago, a king had power and wealth, but he was not happy.
A wise doctor said to find the shirt of a happy man.
The king's men looked everywhere.
At last, they found a happy man singing in a field.
But the happy man had no shirt at all!
exercises.translation_cn:
很久以前,一位国王有权有财,但他并不快乐。
一位智慧的医生说,去找一个快乐的人的衬衫。
国王的人到处寻找。
最后,他们找到了一个在田野里唱歌的快乐的人。
但这个快乐的人根本没有衬衫!

questions.stem: Was the king happy?
What did the wise doctor say to find?
options: The shirt of a happy man.
questions.answer_text: The shirt of a happy man.

questions.stem: Where did they find the happy man?
What did the happy man have?
What does the story teach?
options: Wealth does not always bring happiness.
questions.answer_text: Wealth does not always bring happiness.

exercises.title: 九年级 U11 听力·对话 The Soccer Team
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: You look sad. What's wrong?
M: I missed an important goal, and my team lost.
W: It's not your fault. You win and lose as a team.
M: But I let my teammates down.
W: A real team pulls together. Don't be so hard on yourself.
exercises.translation_cn:
女:你看起来很难过。怎么了?
男:我错过了一个重要进球,我们队输了。
女:这不是你的错。胜负是全队的事。
男:但我让队友失望了。
女:真正的团队会齐心协力。别对自己太苛刻。

questions.stem: Why is the man sad?
options: He missed a goal and his team lost.
questions.answer_text: He missed a goal and his team lost.

questions.stem: What does the woman say about the loss?
How do you win and lose according to the woman?
What does a real team do?
What does the woman tell the man?
options: Don't be so hard on yourself.
questions.answer_text: Don't be so hard on yourself.

exercises.title: 九年级 U11 听力·短文 How Music Affects Us
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: Music has a strong effect on our feelings.
Soft, quiet music can make us feel calm.
Fast, loud music can make us feel excited.
Sad music can make some people cry.
Music is an important part of our lives.
exercises.translation_cn:
音乐对我们的情感有很强的影响。
轻柔安静的音乐能让我们感到平静。
快速响亮的音乐能让我们感到兴奋。
悲伤的音乐能让一些人哭泣。
音乐是我们生活中重要的一部分。

questions.stem: What does music have a strong effect on?
What can soft, quiet music make us feel?
What can fast, loud music make us feel?
What can sad music make some people do?
What is music according to the passage?
options: An important part of our lives.
questions.answer_text: An important part of our lives.

exercises.title: 九年级 U11 听力·对话 Two Friends
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: You seem upset. Is everything OK with Holly?
M: Not really. I feel she's been leaving me out lately.
W: Have you talked to her about it?
M: Not yet. But I'd rather talk than stay angry.
W: That's a good idea. A true friend talks about problems.
exercises.translation_cn:
女:你好像不开心。和霍莉还好吗?
男:不太好。我觉得她最近一直把我晾在一边。
女:你和她谈过了吗?
男:还没。但我宁愿谈一谈,也不愿一直生气。
女:这是个好主意。真正的朋友会谈论问题。

questions.stem: Who is the man upset about?
What does the man feel Holly is doing?
Has the man talked to Holly yet?
What would the man rather do?
What does a true friend do according to the woman?

exercises.title: 九年级 U11 听力·短文 Friendship Week
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: Friendship Week is coming, and friends make our lives better.
On Monday, write a thank-you card to a friend.
On Wednesday, help a classmate with their work.
Helping others makes us both happy.
After all, a life with good friends is a happy life.
exercises.translation_cn:
友谊周就要到了,朋友让我们的生活更美好。
周一,给朋友写一张感谢卡。
周三,帮助同学完成功课。
帮助别人会让我们都开心。
毕竟,有好朋友的人生是幸福的人生。

questions.stem: What makes our lives better?
What should you do on Monday?
What should you do on Wednesday?
What does helping others do?
What kind of life is a happy life?
